calls.line: Hold her straight! Straight down the middle!
calls.subtitle: ARTHUR: Hold her straight! Straight down the middle!

calls.line: Left! Get us left of that!
calls.subtitle: ARTHUR: Left! Get us left of that!
ARTHUR: Bring her right! Right, now!

calls.line: Steady, middle! Don't you touch them!
calls.subtitle: ARTHUR: Steady, middle! Don't you touch them!

calls.line: Hard left, lad! Rocks to starboard!
calls.subtitle: ARTHUR: Hard left, lad! Rocks to starboard!

arrival_line: That's the jetty! Go, go, go - don't you wait for me!
